verdict.rationale: Ramp documents background automation in two ways. Built-in agents run continuously for auto-coding, fraud scanning, approval routing, receipt capture, auto top-up and hotel rebooking. For custom automations, it offers webhooks for event-driven workflows, a CLI built for scripted and scheduled workflows with headless agent login, and 'long-running access for background agents that run on a schedule.' Missing for 10: a native user-facing automation or scheduling builder (custom scheduling relies on external handlers or cron with the CLI), detail on how users configure the built-in agents' rules, and independent or hands-on corroboration that background automations work as claimed.
